Invader.js, Player.js and Genetics.js are loaded as classic scripts. main.js
is kept for the record but is not executed — it registered a service worker
and an appcache, and it owns a single cannon. The GifOS loop (game.js) is
ordinary source beside this directory. The notice travels INSIDE the GIF as
well as beside it here.
